referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official page begins with a black hero, a centered white legal promise, a luminous blue-green justice figure, and a small contact control. A slim side index and oversized numbered chapter markers organize a long scroll through practice areas, a firm vision, testimonials, values, team profiles, legal careers, contact, and office details. The captured desktop and mobile pages show that most pale chapters have white or near-white headings and body copy on light backgrounds, leaving large portions extremely faint and difficult to read. The hero offers a recognizable composition study, but the paired screenshots fail legibility review as a production reference. Keep the dossier ineligible until clearer evidence replaces or resolves the low-contrast chapters. Do not reproduce the source mark, figure, numbers, wording, portraits, testimonials, legal claims, offices, or visual trade dress.
